title: DevForgeAI session evidence
description: Created once per provider session at .devforgeai/sessions/<session_id>.json by the hook-only session-start operation, and appended to whenever this session's runs grant or release a write lease. It is the evidence that the hook chain was armed, what it could resolve at the time, and who held the right to write during the session; it is not a session model, holds no conversation state, and is never read to decide a transition. Every result row and every provenance line carries the session_id that names this file.

session_id.description: The provider's session identifier, taken verbatim from the SessionStart event. 'unknown' when the event carried none.

provider_version.description: The provider version from the event, or 'unknown'.

dispatcher_sha256.description: Content hash of the installed dispatch.py. ABSENT means the dispatcher file is missing, which is the one fault hooks cannot report from a later event.

hooks_armed.description: Whether the dispatcher was present beside the sequencer when the session opened.

state_parsed.description: Whether .devforgeai/state.yaml loaded as a mapping. false means every later policy event fails closed.

stack_resolvable.description: Whether the active run's commands.source anchor resolved to a stack.yaml section. true when no run is active.

at.description: UTC timestamp the file was created. The newest 'at' across the directory names the current session.

lease_events.description: Optional; absent until this session's first grant. One appended row per write-lease grant and release, so the question 'who was allowed to write, in which root, when' is answerable from evidence rather than from a transcript. The lease itself lives in .devforgeai/work/<run>/run.yaml; this is its history.

kind.description: granted is written at SubagentStart, the only identity-bearing pre-write event on both providers; released is written at ingest-result, whatever the receipt's status.

agent.description: The canonical worker name the lease was granted to or released from.

agent_id.description: The start event's agent identity, recorded where the provider supplies one. Absent on Codex, whose PreToolUse carries no identity and whose fence is the candidate root itself.

root.description: The candidate root the lease authorised writes in.
